an.note.booth-scorecard: Support index = (support - opposition) / surveyed voters. Grade A at {0} or more, C at {1} or less, else B. Booths where under {2}% of voters are surveyed are graded on the last election margin of the focus party. Click a number to open those voters.
an.note.worker-coverage: Workers = voters with a membership no., a karyakarta / worker political status, or an organisational role. A booth needs workers when it has none or more than {0} voters per worker.
an.note.voter-sentiment: Political status is grouped by keywords: support / karyakarta / worker / member / loyal = Support; neutral / undecided / swing = Neutral; opposition / against / anti = Opposition. Click a number to open those voters.
an.note.survey-coverage: Coverage score = average of mobile %, political status % and caste %. Voters marked deleted are counted separately.
an.note.caste-booth: Caste as recorded in the field survey, never guessed from names. For planning only.
an.note.household-insights: Houses are matched on house no. (ignoring spaces, hyphens and dots) and address, the same rule as the dashboard. A house whose voters are split over two booths appears in both booths but is counted once in the Total.
an.note.turnout-profile: Compares booth turnout and the focus party's vote share with the share of young, women and senior voters on the roll.
an.note.campaign-reach: SMS / WhatsApp messages per campaign, for voters in the selected assembly / ward.
